name: Chat Tags & Themes
displayDescription:
Allows you to pick and customize your own chat tag from 200+ premade tags. 3 colors slots, 3 gradients, plus other customization.
Also gives access to the themes tab in the menu.

name: Personal Servers
displayDescription:
Allows you to create your own personal server.
You can beat towers in personal servers.

Also gives you the ability to teleport to towers by clicking the difficulty chart labels.

name: Healing Tool
displayDescription: This tool allows you to boost your health regeneration by 5x when standing still in a safe spot where you can't be damaged.
